Tracking issue for **P3.G** — groundwork for Phase 3 of the plan in #1: `particle-worker` in Rust plus the GCP runtime, in this repo.

## Scope
- `rust/particle-core`: SPEC-conformant protocol kernel — event envelope (unknown types preserved), prefixed ids, lamport clocks, canonical total order, deterministic fold, canonical JSON — with the same property tests as the TS kernel (permutation invariance, duplicate idempotence, deterministic claim races).
- `rust/particle-worker`: daemon binary at functional parity with the Phase-0 TS worker — GitHub App auth (RS256 JWT → installation tokens), issue polling with the bot loop-guard, NDJSON journal, fold summaries, `--once`.
- `infra/gcp`: Terraform for a single worker VM — dedicated service account, app credentials in Secret Manager (least-privilege accessor), Debian VM whose startup script builds the worker from this repo and runs it under systemd. Plus `scripts/gcp-upload-secrets.sh`.
- CI: rust job (fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests).

## Non-goals (stay with their owners)
Git ref store (#5 owns the protocol implementation; the Rust side ports it after), conformance corpus (#10 — the Rust kernel is a consumer once it exists), scheduler/runner (#7, #8), autoscaling/containers (later Phase-3 work).

claim: P3.G — this agent is executing.
